created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the skill was created.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description:
Human-readable, single-line label for the Skill. Maximum 255 characters.
Always set: derived from the SKILL.md frontmatter `name` when omitted at
creation. Not unique.

id.title: Id
id.description:
Unique identifier for the skill.

The format and length of IDs may change over time.

latest_version_id.title: Latest Version Id
latest_version_id.description: ID of the newest Skill Version — what `latest` references resolve to. Always set: a Skill holds at least one version.

source.description:
Where the Skill comes from.

Possible values:
* `"custom"`: authored by the platform user; private to their workspace
* `"anthropic"`: published by Anthropic; shared and read-only
* `"anthropic_example"`: Anthropic-published sample Skill
* `"plugin"`: resolved from an installed plugin

type.title: Type
type.description:
Object type.

For Skills, this is always `"skill"`.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the skill was last updated.
